evidence.content: Occasional temperature sensor variance noted on freezer units during summer months. No root cause identified; readings returned to normal on their own each time.

Runbook: Sensor Variance Check
1. Compare readings against the adjacent unit
2. Inspect door seals for condensation
3. If variance persists over 24h, schedule recalibration
4. Escalate only if product temperature exceeds safe range
